subject: [PATCH v6 4/5] mm/memcontrol: move memory stock to page counters

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch moves the memory stock from memcg to page counters, allowing for more flexible management of memory usage. The change decouples the memory and memsw counters, which can temporarily diverge in value. To preserve the legacy user-visible invariant that memory usage is less than or equal to swap usage, the larger raw value between memory and memsw is reported. The patch also removes unused memcg code and preserves existing behaviors for cgroup v2 users. Future work will introduce additional page counters without removing the fast path.
